verdict.rationale: Skills for Real Engineers is a bundle of editable markdown skill files installed into a repo and run by third-party agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot. The product never collects or processes user data, so opting out of model training is a property of the underlying model or agent provider, not of this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it handles data flows that could be used for training, so the privacy-training axis does not apply.
